svg.aria-label: Miyu features. Music: YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, 11 filter presets, lyrics, playlists, 24/7 mode. Guard: antinuke, raid detection, automod, warnings, cases, cross-server ban list. Community: leveling with role rewards, tickets, birthdays, economy, giveaways, trivia, wordle. Failover: probes every Lavalink node and moves players off a dead node with queue, position and filters kept.
